findings.reason: The original two tiles contain only prose. A face-and-stem picture materially clarifies the literal boundary convention in F2 and step 2.1: the stem contributes two inverse occurrences, while the face is traversed clockwise with the complex on the right. This is a warranted explanatory omission under the expanded diagram scope, not a claim that the proof needs a figure.
findings.action: Appended a final Remarks illustration with an explicit clockwise relator boundary, solid conjugating stem, dashed outward/return traversal guides, and a caption distinguishing schematic sides from actual word length.

correction: Added one native TikZ face-and-stem schematic outside the proof; original source retained byte-for-byte as a prefix.

diagram_math_checks.data: One polygonal relator face with corner a, a subdivided stem o-p-a, and no other solid edges.
diagram_math_checks.check: Step 2.1 attaches a path labelled u_k from the common basepoint to a chosen face vertex. The schematic has six vertices and six solid edges: o-p, p-a, a-b, b-c, c-d, d-a. Degrees are 1,2,3,2,2,2 respectively. Filling the four-edge cycle gives one 2-cell and Euler characteristic 6-6+1=1; the stem attached to a disc is connected, planar and contractible.

The explicit coordinates give a clockwise polygon traversal, with the filled face on its right, matching the outer-walk convention in def-van-kampen-diagram-boundary-label-and-area. Step 2.1 specifies the boundary word r_k^{epsilon_k}; the caption explicitly says the four drawn geometric sides are schematic, not four letters or a restriction on relator length. The last edge d-a is explicit and visibly present in the native rendered PNG.

diagram_math_checks.data: Outward stem occurrence u_k and return occurrence u_k^{-1}.
diagram_math_checks.check: The upper dashed arrow goes from the o side toward a; the lower dashed arrow returns toward o. The caption identifies these as occurrences of one solid bridge path, not extra edges. By F2 and step 2.1 the literal excursion is u_k r_k^{epsilon_k} u_k^{-1}; no free reduction is applied. No folding or petal deletion is depicted, and step 1.3 remains the independent rigorous surgery argument.
